about: SOSpesAI scenario library (24). Clinical values pending validation by the health lead. CC0. Generated with AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic).

scenarios.name: Renal colic
scenarios.trigger: Flank pain, blood on the urine dipstick
scenarios.app_action: Protocol + inventory (urine dipsticks missing) + dial; on Mars, ultrasound without live guidance
scenarios.basis: IMM Mars: kidney stones among top drivers of evacuation

scenarios.name: Suspected sepsis
scenarios.trigger: Fever, fast pulse, low blood pressure, high WBC
scenarios.app_action: Intensive monitoring every 15 min; protocol antibiotic; dial (T_crit 1 h)
scenarios.basis: IMM Mars: sepsis, top modelled cause of death

scenarios.name: Suspected appendicitis
scenarios.app_action: No surgery on board: antibiotics protocol, evacuation assessment by profile
scenarios.basis: IMM Mars; most common patrol-threatening case on Vanguard submarines

scenarios.name: Chemical eye burn
scenarios.app_action: Immediate action (irrigation) without waiting: the dial always shows CREW
scenarios.basis: IMM Mars: top driver of evacuation

scenarios.name: Trauma (fall, blow, fracture)
scenarios.trigger: Fall during EVA or in the habitat
scenarios.app_action: Immobilisation with what is in the inventory; capability lost if no splint
scenarios.basis: IMPACT, long lunar mission: trauma among the largest risks

scenarios.name: Decompression sickness after a spacewalk
scenarios.trigger: Joint pain or neurological symptoms after EVA
scenarios.app_action: Intensive monitoring after each EVA; recompression protocol if it exists
scenarios.basis: IMPACT, long lunar mission: main contributor to risk

scenarios.name: Respiratory failure
scenarios.app_action: Oxygen from the inventory; continuous monitoring
scenarios.basis: IMPACT, long lunar mission

scenarios.name: Smoke inhalation (fire on board)
scenarios.app_action: Several affected at once; oxygen and triage
scenarios.basis: IMM Mars: smoke inhalation among modelled causes of death

scenarios.name: High cabin CO2
scenarios.app_action: Links symptoms across the crew to the environment; not an individual problem
scenarios.basis: Symptoms from 2.3 mmHg; ISS limit 3.0 mmHg

scenarios.name: Solar storm (particle event)
scenarios.profiles: lunar transit, lunar surface, Mars transit, Mars surface
scenarios.app_action: Shelter warning; event dose vs the 250 mSv per-event limit
scenarios.basis: NASA-STD-3001

scenarios.name: Radiation dose budget
scenarios.trigger: Cumulative dose approaching the career limit
scenarios.app_action: Projection to mission end vs 600 mSv
scenarios.basis: NASA-STD-3001; 1.8 mSv/day in transit to Mars

scenarios.name: Eye changes (SANS) without symptoms
scenarios.app_action: Grey zone on the 3D body; OCT brought forward if a blackout is coming
scenarios.basis: Optic disc edema in 9 of 13 crew by day 150

scenarios.name: Jugular thrombosis without symptoms
scenarios.app_action: Anticoagulation decision with inventory and dial
scenarios.basis: Abnormal flow in 6 of 11 crew, 1 thrombus

scenarios.name: Progressive bone loss
scenarios.app_action: Evolution and projection; more exercise
scenarios.basis: 1-1.5% per month

scenarios.name: Sleep loss and accumulated fatigue
scenarios.app_action: Intensive level; discordance if the self-report says 'fine'
scenarios.basis: About 6 h of sleep on average on the ISS

scenarios.name: Low mood, disconnection from Earth
scenarios.trigger: Voice and message volume drop for weeks
scenarios.app_action: Trend + discreet notice + private conference; never without permission
scenarios.basis: Disconnection observed in Mars-500 and SIRIUS-19

scenarios.name: Virus reactivation (shingles)
scenarios.app_action: 72 h window for antivirals; inventory
scenarios.basis: Reactivation in 61% of ISS crew

scenarios.name: The medical officer is the patient
scenarios.app_action: The app guides another crew member step by step in plain language
scenarios.basis: CMO training of about 15 h

scenarios.name: Several affected at once
scenarios.app_action: Crew triage and sharing limited resources
scenarios.basis: Team assumption

scenarios.name: A medical device fails
scenarios.app_action: 'What do we lose if...?': conditions that lose their test or treatment
scenarios.basis: Team assumption

scenarios.name: A drug runs out or degrades
scenarios.app_action: Protocol alternatives; capabilities at risk
scenarios.basis: Drugs failed before expiry after 28 months on the ISS

scenarios.name: Incident during a communications blackout
scenarios.profiles: lunar surface without relay, Mars transit (conjunction)
scenarios.app_action: Dial on CREW; log to send later
scenarios.basis: 17 days with no link in the 2028 conjunction (team table); half-month lunar visibility

scenarios.name: Return to gravity
scenarios.app_action: Recovery tracking against the preflight reference
scenarios.basis: Post-flight phase

scenarios.name: Evacuation decision
scenarios.app_action: Compares the profile's evacuation time with the critical time
scenarios.basis: Crew-11: first ISS medical evacuation, January 2026 [secondary source]
